findings: The recorded architecture defines a multi-game system powered by one Question Bank.
GAME-01=OLYMPIA is explicitly a first template, not the complete game subsystem; this permits additional game templates to consume the shared Question Bank without duplicating or changing it.
The Product Manager output is consistent supporting evidence but was independently checked against both authoritative sources.
This is an architectural-direction finding only; it does not certify an implemented template interface or runtime behavior.
checks_performed: Read the installed Multi-Agent Systems Architect role definition.

unresolved_risks: The authoritative records do not specify a versioned template-to-Question-Bank interface, ownership boundaries, compatibility rules, or migration policy.
Automated evidence is still needed to prove that adding another template neither duplicates nor mutates Question Bank data.
